sentences.l2: 在当代城市化进程的纵深推进中，公共交通系统作为城市机能的动脉，其环境效益早已超越单纯的运输功能，演变为维系生态平衡与可持续发展的重要战略支点。
sentences.l1: In the deepening advance of contemporary urbanization, the public transport system, as the artery of urban function, has long since gone beyond a mere transport function in its environmental benefit, evolving into an important strategic fulcrum for sustaining ecological balance and sustainable development.

sentences.l2: 当个体选择地铁、公交或共享轨道交通作为日常通勤的主要载体，其行为本质上构成对私人机动化出行模式的系统性替代，由此引发的连锁效应深刻重塑了城市的污染谱系。
sentences.l1: When individuals choose the subway, the bus or shared rail transit as the main vehicle for daily commuting, their behavior essentially constitutes a systematic replacement of the private motorized travel model, and the chain effects thus triggered have profoundly reshaped the pollution spectrum of the city.

sentences.l2: 传统燃油汽车在频繁启停与怠速运行中释放的氮氧化物、颗粒物及挥发性有机化合物，是城市雾霾与光化学烟雾形成的关键前体物；而规模化公共交通网络通过集约化载客显著稀释了人均排放强度，使得单位客运量所产生的环境污染降至个体交通的零头。
sentences.l1: The nitrogen oxides, particulate matter and volatile organic compounds released by traditional fuel-powered cars during frequent stopping and starting and idling are key precursors in the formation of urban smog and photochemical smog; while large-scale public transport networks, through intensive passenger carrying, significantly dilute the per-capita emission intensity, reducing the environmental pollution produced per unit of passenger traffic to a mere fraction of that of individual transport.

sentences.l2: 更为关键的是，在全生命周期碳核算框架下，公共交通即使计入车辆制造、能源生产与基础设施维护的隐含碳排放，其人均碳足迹仍较私家车通勤低达60%以上——这一数据在高密度城市语境中甚至可攀升至75%，凸显其在减缓全球气候变暖进程中的不可替代性。
sentences.l1: More crucially, under the framework of full life-cycle carbon accounting, even when the embodied carbon emissions of vehicle manufacturing, energy production and infrastructure maintenance are counted, the per-capita carbon footprint of public transport is still up to more than 60% lower than that of commuting by private car; in the context of high-density cities, this figure can even climb to 75%, highlighting its irreplaceability in slowing the process of global warming.

sentences.l2: 从城市规划的宏观视阈审视，公共交通导向型开发（TOD）模式已从理论构想升华为全球大都市空间重构的核心范式。
sentences.l1: Viewed from the macro perspective of urban planning, the transit-oriented development (TOD) model has been elevated from a theoretical concept to the core paradigm of the spatial restructuring of the world's major cities.

sentences.l2: 该模式通过将高容量轨道交通站点与混合功能用地布局进行耦合设计，使居住、就业、商业与公共服务在步行可达范围内高度集聚，从而在空间结构层面抑制了长距离通勤的刚性需求。
sentences.l1: This model, by coupling the design of high-capacity rail transit stations with a mixed-function land-use layout, makes residence, employment, commerce and public services highly concentrated within walking distance, thereby suppressing, at the level of spatial structure, the rigid demand for long-distance commuting.

sentences.l2: 这种“以流定形”的规划哲学，不仅压缩了通勤距离与时间成本，更从根本上瓦解了城市蔓延（urban sprawl）所依赖的低密度扩张逻辑，使土地利用效率与环境承载力达成动态耦合。
sentences.l1: This planning philosophy of "letting flow shape form" not only compresses commuting distance and time cost, but also fundamentally dismantles the low-density expansion logic on which urban sprawl depends, bringing land-use efficiency and environmental carrying capacity into dynamic coupling.

sentences.l2: 实证研究表明，TOD区域居民的日均机动车出行频次较传统社区降低40%，而骑行与步行等零碳出行方式的分担率则提升近三倍，形成自强化的环保正循环。
sentences.l1: Empirical research shows that the daily frequency of motor vehicle trips of residents in TOD areas is 40% lower than in traditional communities, while the share of zero-carbon travel modes such as cycling and walking rises by nearly three times, forming a self-reinforcing positive cycle of environmental protection.

sentences.l2: 进一步解构“环保”这一复合型价值命题，公共交通的生态意义已从单纯的污染物减排，延展至生态系统服务功能的修复与再生。
sentences.l1: In further deconstructing "environmental protection" as a composite value proposition, the ecological significance of public transport has extended from the mere reduction of pollutant emissions to the restoration and regeneration of ecosystem service functions.

sentences.l2: 当城市道路资源从私人汽车的过度占用中被释放，其空间再分配可催生大规模绿色基础设施建设：原本用于停车的空间转化为线性公园、雨水花园与生物廊道，不仅增强城市碳汇能力，更缓解热岛效应并提升生物多样性。
sentences.l1: When urban road resources are released from excessive occupation by private cars, their spatial reallocation can give rise to large-scale green infrastructure construction: space originally used for parking is converted into linear parks, rain gardens and biological corridors, which not only strengthen the city's carbon sink capacity, but also alleviate the heat island effect and enhance biodiversity.

sentences.l2: 此外，电动化公交 fleet 的普及与可再生能源供电系统的整合，正在推动交通运输部门实现深度脱碳。
sentences.l1: In addition, the spread of electrified bus fleets and the integration of renewable energy power supply systems are driving the transport sector to achieve deep decarbonization.

sentences.l2: 在政策工具与技术创新的双重驱动下，公共交通已成为连接个体行为选择与全球环境治理的微观枢纽——每个乘客在刷卡入闸的瞬间，实际上都在以具身化的方式参与一场分布式环境治理实践，其累积效应足以对国家乃至全球的碳预算产生实质性影响。
sentences.l1: Under the dual drive of policy instruments and technological innovation, public transport has become a micro hub connecting individual behavioral choices with global environmental governance: at the moment each passenger taps a card to pass through the gate, they are in fact participating in an embodied way in a practice of distributed environmental governance, and its cumulative effect is enough to have a substantive impact on the carbon budget of the nation and even the world.

sentences.l2: 这种将日常通勤转化为生态公民实践的转化机制，正是现代城市文明迈向韧性与公正转型的深层密码。
sentences.l1: This mechanism of transformation that turns daily commuting into the practice of ecological citizenship is precisely the deep code of modern urban civilization's move toward a resilient and just transition.
